main.description: One stream overlay for OBS (or anything that takes a browser source), shown at dame.is/overlay/{rkey} on a 1920x1080 canvas. The record key is the overlay's id in that address: lowercase letters, digits and dashes. Widgets are placed on the site's own page grid carried onto the canvas: 16 columns and 9 rows of square 92px cells with 24px gutters, the same column and gutter as the site's grid at a desktop width. The page reads the record from the PDS without signing in and follows changes live, so a save shows on stream within seconds. Edited in the admin's Overlays studio. The structure follows atpota.to's to.atpota.poe.overlay, with its full-screen scenes folded in: a scene here is an overlay with an opaque backdrop.

name.description: What the overlay is called in the studio ("starting soon").

backdrop.description: transparent: nothing behind the widgets, to sit over a capture. page: the hour's page colour fills the canvas, for a full-screen scene. Absent is transparent.

hour.description: Paint the overlay in this hour's sky palette (Eastern hours, as the site). Absent follows the clock, so the overlay drifts through the day with the site.

grid.description: Draw the page grid's column and row lines faintly on the canvas, as the site draws its columns.

widgets.description: What is on the canvas, painted in order (a later widget sits over an earlier one where they overlap).

kind.description: title: words the overlay sets (a heading and a line under it). text: words set a line each, in one of the site's voices, optionally running as a ticker. countdown: to a time, or a timer from when the overlay is shown. clock: the time now. tid: the time now as an atproto TID, ticking, and optionally the repo's latest revision. day: the day of life, as the site's chrome counts it. status: the latest is.dame.now. music: what teal.fm says is playing. vitals: the latest is.dame.state. atmosphere: the network's weather from atpota.to's weather station, in one of its styles. chat: the stream.place chat (place.stream.chat.message records naming this repo as the streamer). poe: atpota.to's potato, which greets chatters, thanks followers, says weather alerts and answers chat commands. frame: an empty, ruled window to line a screen or camera capture up with. mark: the hour's sky avatar and the wordmark. links: where to find dame, a line each.

col.description: The grid column its left edge is on.

row.description: The grid row its top edge is on.

surface.description: What it is drawn on: nothing, a plate of the page colour, the chrome's raised surface, the page at two thirds (veil), the accent filled, the page turned over (ink ground, page-coloured words), or the hour's sky (the avatar's top and bottom bands). The plates are ruled with a hairline. Absent is page.

scale.description: Its type size, in percent of the usual.

align.description: Where its words sit across its box.

size.description: title: how big the heading is set.

text.description: title: the heading. frame: its name (the studio's, and its nameplate's).

subtitle.description: title: the line under the heading.

label.description: The small-caps line over a widget's reading ("starting in", "dame is listening"). Absent is the widget's own; an empty string drops it.

mode.description: countdown: a timer of `minutes` from when the overlay is shown, or to the time `at`.

at.description: countdown: the time it counts to.

done.description: countdown: what it says at zero.

zone.description: clock: New York time (the site's clock) or the streaming machine's own.

max.description: chat: how many messages at most.

art.description: music: show the album cover. mark: show the sky avatar.

lines.description: links and text: one line each.

voice.description: text: which of the site's voices it is set in.

ticker.description: text: run its lines along one line, round and round, instead of stacking them.

style.description: How it looks, for the kinds with more than one way. atmosphere: card, strip, badge, apps, forecast, pulse. tid: ticking (the TID with the time it means and the day), mini (the TID alone). Absent or unknown is the kind's first.

repo.description: tid: also show the repo's latest revision, itself a TID, and how long ago it moved.

side.description: poe: which side of its box Poe sits on; it faces into the screen from there.

greet.description: poe: say hello to chatters and answer chat commands.

alerts.description: poe: say weather alerts (storms, apps blowing in).

volume.description: poe: how loud its noises are; 0 is silent.

nap.description: poe: minutes of quiet before it naps; 0 never.

shape.description: frame: a rectangle, or a circle inside its box (for a round camera).

plate.description: frame: show its name on stream, on a small plate at its foot.
